zh.title: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空福克100客機瓦尼莫起飛發動機異常中斷起飛
zh.summary: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空福克100客機11月21日於瓦尼莫起飛加速時，一具發動機轉速回落並伴隨異響，機組於極低速度中斷起飛並滑回停機坪；巴布亞紐幾內亞事故調查委員會正評估是否展開獨立安全調查。
body: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空福克100客機、機身編號P2-ANH，11月21日執行PX-141航班由瓦尼莫飛往威瓦克。客機於瓦尼莫12號跑道加速起飛時，一具發動機轉速回落並發出一連串異響，隨後轉速回升又再次回落並伴隨異響。機組於極低速度中斷起飛，飛機滑回停機坪。
巴布亞紐幾內亞事故調查委員會表示，正在評估這起於瓦尼莫機場通報的發動機相關中斷起飛事件，以決定是否展開獨立安全調查；若不展開調查，將把事件移交巴布亞紐幾內亞民航安全局進行適當的監管安全評估與後續處理。

en.title: Air Niugini Fokker 100 rejects takeoff at Vanimo after engine problem
en.summary: An Air Niugini Fokker 100 rejected takeoff at very low speed at Vanimo on November 21 after one of its engines rolled back with a series of chatter sounds during the takeoff roll. The aircraft returned to the apron, and Papua New Guinea's Accident Investigation Commission is assessing whether an independent safety investigation is warranted.
body: An Air Niugini Fokker 100, registration P2-ANH, performing flight PX-141 from Vanimo to Wewak in Papua New Guinea, was accelerating the engines for takeoff from Vanimo's runway 12 when one of the engines rolled back with a series of chatter sounds, accelerated again, and chattered again rolling down. The crew rejected takeoff at very low speed. The aircraft returned to the apron.

Papua New Guinea's Accident Investigation Commission reported: "The AIC is assessing a reported engine-related aborted take-off at Vanimo Airport (VAI) earlier today to determine whether an independent safety investigation is warranted. If not, the matter will be referred to CASA PNG for appropriate regulatory safety assessment and follow-up."

facts.claim: Air Niugini Fokker 100 P2-ANH operated flight PX-141 from Vanimo to Wewak.
During the takeoff roll on runway 12, one engine rolled back with a series of chatter sounds, accelerated again, then chattered again rolling down.
The crew rejected takeoff at very low speed and the aircraft returned to the apron.

Papua New Guinea's Accident Investigation Commission said it is assessing the reported engine-related aborted takeoff to determine whether an independent safety investigation is warranted, and if not, the matter will be referred to CASA PNG.
